faq: Which tool will the page be built in?

We use whatever suits you: Webflow, Framer, WordPress or plain code. If you have no preference we pick the lowest cost option that you can edit without a developer. The choice is confirmed before work starts.
Do you write the words on the page?
We write a draft from your product notes and refine it with you. You know your customers best, so we ask for your edits. We do not invent customer quotes or fake numbers.
Into the tool you already use, such as Mailchimp, Kit or a simple spreadsheet, or into one we set up for free. The list belongs to you. We include the consent wording each sign-up form needs.
Can the page be updated after launch?
Yes. The page is built so you can change text and images yourself. We include a short edit guide. Larger changes later can be quoted as a separate fixed price order.
